data.title: 摩根 · 冬宫雪庭
data.description: 【摩根 · 冬宫雪庭】冬宫的雪庭里，摩根独自立于漫天飞雪之中，黑蓝长裙与银发几乎融进雪光，只有王冠与冰瞳仍是触目的冷色——「雪落无声，正如王座之上的岁月。」
data.action: 独自站在雪庭空地，双手轻合在身前，抬眼看落雪
data.camera: full-body frontal shot, solitary standing figure in open snowy garden
data.promptProse: Morgan watches falling snow, hands joined before her. Snow-reflected light softens her silver hair against the shaded palace walls.
data.animaCaption: Her joined hands rest before her against the shaded palace wall.
